title: Moonlit Messages
intro: The last train no longer runs, but someone is still waiting. Talk to the townspeople and uncover the story of an unsent letter.
label: Message
hint: Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a new line
ready: Start with a hello. Your conversations are saved automatically.
waiting: A reply is on its way…
failed: Connection or save failed. Reconnect to recover.
conflict: The save has changed. Reconnect to load the latest records.
runFailed: This reply failed. Your history remains; you can send another message.
aborted: Reply stopped. Your chat history is retained.
incomplete: The previous reply was interrupted. Your history remains; send a new message to continue.

lamplighter.name: Lin
lamplighter.bio: Still lights the last lantern every evening at seven.
lamplighter.opening:
Lin has accepted your contact request.
Ask why the lanterns still glow at a closed station.

archivist.name: Xu
archivist.bio: Collects old timetables and unfinished conversations.
archivist.opening:
You found Xu's contact on the station noticeboard.
Perhaps she knows who wrote the unsent letter.

objective: Inspect the station. Ask Lin and Xu about the letter, then deliver it across the river.
closed: Case closed. The letter is on its way to the bookshop. You can keep talking to the witnesses.
noEvidence: Your notebook is empty. Click the marked objects in the scene to investigate.
discovered: Evidence recorded. Ask a witness what it means.

clock.name: Platform clock
clock.detail: The hands stopped at seven. A scratched arrow points below the clock.

notice.name: Noticeboard
notice.detail: A bookshop across the river is run by the former stationmaster’s daughter. Xu has marked its address.

letter.name: Hidden letter
letter.detail: Beneath the clock lies an unsent letter: “I regret our last argument.” The envelope is addressed to the stationmaster’s daughter.

settings.showHintsHelp: Show send and line-break hints below the conversation input.
settings.textSizeHelp: Adjust the text size in conversations and the input box.
